text:
Hi Sarah,

Just following up on the quote I sent over on Tuesday for the fire door inspections at the Leicester site. Um, we can do the 14th or the 21st of March, whichever suits you better. The price is still £1,450 plus VAT. Let me know if you've got any questions.

Cheers,
Ryan
Hi John, sorry I'm running about 20 minutes late, the traffic on the M1 is, like, absolutely awful. I should be with you by about half 10. Thanks, Ryan

Hello Mark,

I hope you're well. I'm just chasing invoice 4471 which was due on the 3rd of November. I know things have been busy your end, but could you let me know when we can expect payment? If there's a problem with it, just give me a ring on 07700 900123.

Kind regards,
Ryan Murphy

Hi Dave, so, um, I've had a look at the samples you sent and honestly the grey ones are, you know, a lot better than the black ones. The black ones sort of scuff really easily. Can we can we go with 200 of the grey in the large size and 50 in the medium? And, er, if you could get them to us before the 1st of December that would be brilliant because we've got the Jason's training day on the 2nd. Cheers, Ryan

Hi Mrs Patel,

Thanks for getting in touch and I'm really sorry about the delay with the alarm service. That's not the standard we aim for. Our engineer Tom will come out on Friday the 8th between 9 and 12 to finish the job, and there won't be any charge for the extra visit.

Best wishes,
Ryan

Hi team, the Monday stand up is moving to 9:30 from next week because a few people have the school run. Same Teams link as before. If 9:30 doesn't work for you just message me and we'll sort something out.
Thanks Priya, that's perfect, I'll get it signed and back to you tomorrow.

Hi Emma,

Quick one. Is the 15% discount you mentioned on the phone for the first year only or for the whole 3 year contract? I need to know before I take it to Jason on Thursday.

Thanks,
Ryan
Alright mate, are you still up for the match on Saturday? Kick off's at 3 so I was thinking we meet at the Swan at about 1. Let me know.

Hi Lucy,

While I'm off next week, can you keep an eye on the Hinckley job? The scaffold's coming down on Wednesday and the client wants photos of the finished roof. Also, the van's MOT is due on the 12th so it needs booking in. Gary has the keys.

Thanks,
Ryan
Yeah so I've pushed the fix for the login bug, it should be live in about 10 minutes. Can someone check it on their phone once it's up?
I'm not sure that's right to be honest. The numbers I've got say we did 312 jobs in October, not 280. Can you double check the report?
So, um, basically, like, the client's, er, asked if we can, you know, move the install to next Thursday instead. I said I'd check with you first. Is that, like, OK?
Can you send me the, sorry, can you share the spreadsheet with Jason and copy me in? The one with the Q3 figures.
I think the delivery might be Wednesday but I'm not 100% sure, I'll confirm once I hear back from the warehouse.
Has anyone got the access code for the Coventry site? Gary's stood outside and can't get in.
Brilliant work on the Northampton bid everyone 🎉 we won it! Drinks are on me Friday.
The Supabase migration failed again on staging, looks like the RLS policy on the deals table is blocking the insert. I'll have a look after lunch.

Site visit notes. Fire extinguishers on the 2nd floor are out of date, 3 of them. Emergency lighting in the stairwell failed the test. The fire log book hasn't been filled in since August. Need to quote for replacement extinguishers and a lighting repair.
Called Steve at Harrison Builders. He wants a training session for 12 people, probably early January. Budget is around £2,000. Send him dates by Friday.

So I was thinking, um, what if we, like, sent a reminder text the day before every inspection? Because loads of people forget and we end up driving out for nothing. It'd probably save us, I don't know, 2 or 3 wasted trips a week.

Things to do before the audit:
1. Update the risk assessments
2. Check the first aid kits
3. Print the training records
The new starter. Will need a. Full induction on Monday and then. Shadowing with Tom for the rest of the week.
Really proud of the team this year. We've trained over 1,200 people in fire safety across the Midlands and we've only been going 3 years. Massive thanks to every client who trusted us.
Sorry I missed your call earlier, I was on a roof. What's up? I'm free after 4.
No, we can't do it for that price. £800 is the lowest we can go and that's already a discount.
Can you organise the colour samples for the centre and analyse which one the customers favour? Ideally by the end of the programme.
Send the signed form to ryan.murphy@ftc-ss.com and copy in accounts@ftc-ss.com please, the reference is FTC-2291.

Um, can you write me a Python script that, like, reads all the CSV files in a folder and merges them into one, and it should skip any rows where the email column is empty. Oh and keep the header from the first file only.
I want a LinkedIn post about our new fire marshal course, it's half a day, £95 a person, starts in February in Leicester. Keep it friendly and not salesy, and no hashtags.

Hi Jason,

Quick update on where we are. The Echo release went out yesterday and so far there's been no crash reports, which is good. The CRM side is a bit behind, the inbox work is probably another week. I've also spoken to the accountant about the VAT return and she says it's due on the 7th of December, so we need the receipts in by the 1st. One more thing, the Azure bill was higher than expected this month, about £140, I'll look into why.

Cheers,
Ryan
